name: Side Plank
pose: Forearm side plank with stacked feet

Exercise: FOREARM SIDE PLANK. Body on LEFT side, left elbow directly below left shoulder, left forearm on floor perpendicular to body with palm flat. Both legs straight, right foot stacked atop left foot; outer edge of left shoe supports lower end. Lift hips to straight shoulder-hip-ankle line, torso faces CAMERA and shoulders/hips stacked, no sag. Right hand rests on right hip with elbow pointing upward. Neutral head aligned spine looking forward. LOW front-side near-orthographic view revealing full body, elbow contact, stacked shoes and exposed flank. Highlight visible OBLIQUES and adjacent abdominal region only, no shoulder/arm/leg overlay. No mat/equipment.

review.notes: One forearm and outer edge of stacked feet support body; supporting elbow under shoulder and free hand on hip. Legs straight, hips elevated near shoulder-to-ankle line. Visible flank overlay only.
review.independentNotes: Independent visual review: forearm and stacked feet support raised hips, shoulder near supporting elbow and broadly aligned trunk. Visible oblique target overlay; hidden supporting-side anatomy is not illustrated.
